instruction: Rename the column header in cell C1 from 'date' to 'publication date' in the opened spreadsheet.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome, navigated to arxiv search, tried advanced search with date filter for Oct 11 2023, but got stuck in loops on arxiv main page. Never extracted paper data or entered anything into the spreadsheet. Accidentally opened GIMP. Task limit reached after 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome and type URLs, navigate arxiv, switch between applications, interact with LibreOffice Calc window
metadata.failure_analysis: Complex multi-step task requiring web research + data extraction + spreadsheet entry was too difficult. Model couldn't find specific papers and got stuck navigating arxiv without making progress.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original complex task into a simple single-cell edit in the already-open spreadsheet, within the model's demonstrated ability to interact with LibreOffice Calc.
metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming a column header in the spreadsheet. Evaluator reads cell C1 and checks it matches 'publication date' (case-insensitive).
